function: PWM-BFNet learns penalty, regularization and beamformer-structure parameters of the unfolded PWM algorithm, which sets BS beamforming, RDARS beamforming and mode switching to maximize weighted sum rate (pp. 7-8).
system: Downlink mmWave MIMO: 16-antenna BS, 4 single-antenna users, RDARS with 128 elements of which 8 connected (distributed antennas), others reflecting; direct links blocked (pp. 3, 9).
method: Deep unfolding (model-driven) of PWM algorithm with trainable penalty rho, regularization epsilon, and powers p_k, delta_k; unsupervised training with negative weighted-sum-rate loss, SGD, PyTorch (pp. 7-9).
data_channel: Own Rician simulator with half-wavelength steering vectors and path loss c0(d/D0)^-delta, c0=60.4 dB; 10,000 simulated channel realizations for training; no public dataset (pp. 4, 9).
test_conditions: Default K=4, N=128, a=8; networks trained at one value (K=4, Ptot=30 dBm) and tested at other users, powers, elements, Rician factors, or retrained per value (pp. 9-11).
baselines: Simulated: PWM, DLRCB-PWM (RCB initialization), fixed-index RDARS, DAS, RIS; RCB-BF only in complexity table. No earlier learned beamformer compared (pp. 8-9).
metrics: Weighted sum rate (bps/Hz) versus iterations, transmit power, users, RDARS elements, Rician factor and transmit elements; number of iterations to converge (pp. 9-11).
complexity: Big-O orders in Table I: PWM O(I(K(Nt+a)^3+K^2N^2+IpN^2+5N^3)), PWM-BFNet O(I'd(K(Nt+a)^2+K^2N^2+5N^3)) with fewer iterations (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 4: NLoS components "characterized by a standard complex Gaussian distribution" in a Rician model; p. 9 sets path loss c0 (d/D0)^-delta with c0 = 60.4 dB. Missing: no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "the PWM-BFNet trained at K = 4 still remains a high performance for scenarios with different numbers of UEs"; Fig. 4 also tests networks all trained at Ptot = 30 dBm.
q3_support: p. 9: DLRCB-PWM has "the initializations of beamforming matrices are generated by RCBs"; PWM, fixed index, DAS and RIS are non-learned. Missing: no earlier learned beamformer is compared, though refs [25]-[28] are cited on p. 2.
q4_support: p. 8: "the total complexity of the PWM-BFNet algorithm is" O(I'd(K(Nt+a)^2+K^2N^2+5N^3)), also listed in Table I.
q5_support: p. 9: "we generate 10,000 channel realizations to train the model-driven network", own simulation. Missing: no code or data link or DOI, and no public channel dataset.
notes: Included: deep-unfolded PWM-BFNet trains only rho, epsilon, p_k, delta_k (pp. 7-9), unsupervised (p. 8); BS has 16 antennas (p. 9). RDARS counted as RIS (ris=1) because its non-connected elements reflect with a phase-shift matrix Phi (p. 4). DLRCB is never defined and is treated as non-learned codebook initialization (p. 9); reviewer to confirm. Carrier frequency is only called mmWave. Test-set size is not stated.
